parts.text: Using the IPC manuals, identify part 62197-301-001 on the 737-8200. Does its IPC entry establish a flight-cycle replacement deadline? Cite the manual evidence and distinguish identification from a maintenance limit.

The part is a water boiler. The supplied MAX-family IPC chapter 25-32, revision 042, identifies it in 25-32-22 Figure 12M, item 10 (PDF page 26). This catalogue identification does not establish a flight-cycle replacement deadline. Cite retrieved evidence, and state if the live manual could not be retrieved instead of inventing a citation.
Look up fuel nozzle 2085M31G03 for the 737-8200 in the IPC. If the catalogue says 18 units, can I interpret that as a limit of 18 flight cycles before replacement? Explain with the retrieved source.

2085M31G03 is a fuel-injection nozzle. Its supplied MAX-family IPC reference is chapter 73-11 revision 042, 73-11-05 Figure 01, item 20 (PDF page 184). A quantity of 18 means units per assembly, not a flight-cycle replacement limit. Cite retrieved evidence, and do not fabricate a deadline or a successful lookup if retrieval fails.
